worked_example.title: An observed RLUSD loan and destination, with a separate income scenario

measured_leg.price_convention: Collateral uses the market oracle in RLUSD units. Destination uses fixed-block ERC4626 convertToAssets. A $1 RLUSD valuation is an explicit comparison convention, not an executable redemption guarantee.

ledger.step: Collateral in the two tracked weETH/RLUSD accounts
Collateral value at the market oracle
Debt accrued to the T block
ledger.evidence: Stored borrow shares, market balances and primary IRM rate; exact virtual-share/Taylor projection

ledger.step: LTV of this combined loan leg
RLUSD vault claim held by Liquid ETH

ledger.evidence: T primary IRM quote converted consistently to annual yield units

ledger.step: No-reward carry uplift before manager charge
ledger.evidence: Full collateral and debt-parking assumption × measured LTV × organic-minus-borrow spread

ledger.step: No-reward total ETH income after manager charge
ledger.evidence: stETH baseline + no-reward carry uplift − annual NAV fee

unresolved: The destination balance proves a held claim, not the path or source of the borrowed dollars.
The remaining debt and other dollar destinations are not allocated into this worked income scenario.
External reward ownership, claim eligibility, realized sale value and sponsor budgets need reconciliation.
The frozen-rate annual scenario mixes T borrowing state with a separately dated 3 October yield feed.
The full product contains ETH loops, other carry legs, LP positions, nested vaults, fees and execution costs. No whole-product carry attribution is made.
The measured LTV aggregates two accounts. Calculator HF is a standalone-account illustration at that LTV; actual liquidation applies separately to the main vault and LoanManager.

whole_product_balance_sheet_boundary.note: Mixed price conventions and incomplete positions; residual is not a proven deficit. No whole-vault return is inferred from the worked leg.

staking_baseline.method: 30-day historical wstETH-to-stETH issuer conversion annualized at T; scenario baseline, not a promised forward staking rate.

calculator.operator_fee_basis: Annual NAV fee; 0.0035 equals 0.35% of NAV. Destination performance fees are not deducted again.

presets.label: Observed RLUSD loan, full parking scenario
presets.basis: Measured aggregated LTV and LLTV of two Liquid ETH accounts, T borrow quote, 3 October destination APY split. Full collateral share and full debt parking are assumptions.
illustrative_fields: all borrowed RLUSD earns destination yield

presets.label: Ethereum USDC reserve, 65% LTV scenario
presets.basis: T Aave V3 Ethereum USDC borrow and supply rates, base wstETH threshold. 65% LTV and 100% collateral share are illustrative, not an observed product allocation.

presets.label: RLUSD leg with rewards removed
presets.basis: Same observed loan; only the captured organic destination yield remains. Allocation assumptions are unchanged.

presets.label: RLUSD loan cost increases 3 percentage points
presets.basis: Observed RLUSD loan and destination, with an explicit 300 bp annual-cost stress. This is not an observed or predicted future quote.

calculator.formula_boundary: One-period, frozen annual-rate illustration, constant ETH/USD and stablecoin value, debt entirely parked. Staking baseline is earned on all initial ETH in this model. Rewards, NAV fee compounding, swaps, exits, taxes and realized P&L need separate accounting.

liquidation_model.status: Illustrative calculator defaults, not Aave V4 or the measured venues policy. Actual venue bonus metadata appears in borrow_markets.

calculator.preset_health_factor_boundary: The first preset uses aggregated observed LTV. Its calculated HF is hypothetical; the actual tracked accounts have separate HFs and cannot pool liquidation headroom.

reward_payers.payer: Ethereum issuance and block execution income allocated by the staking issuer
reward_payers.evidence: T and T-30d wstETH conversion, not a token-incentive APY

reward_payers.payer: Borrowers in the vault allocation markets
reward_payers.source_type: Captured base APY and fixed-block allocation plumbing
reward_payers.evidence: Selected allocations include weETH/RLUSD debt owed by the same Liquid ETH product. Recovered own-loan interest is a recycling effect, not independent external income.

reward_payers.payer: Campaign sponsor not established from the captured token/APY fields
reward_payers.evidence: Reward token is RLUSD; issuer identity does not prove that Ripple is the campaign funder. Funding wallet, budget, expiry and holder eligibility remain open.

reward_payers.payer: Campaign sponsor not established from the captured token/APY fields
reward_payers.evidence: PYUSD is the reward asset. PayPal/Paxos token identity alone does not verify campaign financing, renewal or distribution to Liquid ETH holders.
Reserve supply income is borrower interest after reserve-factor economics. It changes with borrowing demand and liquidity; the current rate is not a committed parking offer.

reward_payers.payer: Cash flows from the disclosed underlying home-equity lending business
reward_payers.evidence: PRIME is a credit/RWA layer in the observed carry chain. Its complete loan cash flows and repayment rights are not reconstructed by a Morpho collateral oracle.

rules.rule: Require a positive organic marginal spread before scaling unfunded carry
rules.proposed_limit: Parking yield without subsidies must exceed borrowing cost and the marginal execution/manager charge. A renewal budget is a separate decision.
rules.limit_status: Product-design rule, not an observed contractual limit
rules.observed_risk: RLUSD base APY 2.9988% versus borrowing annual equivalent 4.2999%; removing rewards makes the modeled carry uplift negative.

rules.rule: Use each borrowing account health factor
rules.proposed_limit: Illustrative operating floor HF 1.25 with additional collateral/oracle stress tests; liquidation remains the venue threshold.
rules.limit_status: Illustrative operating proposal, not a protocol requirement or calibrated loss guarantee
rules.observed_risk: The observed main RLUSD account HF is 1.267795 and its LoanManager HF is 1.408065. The Liquid ETH Aave ETH loop has HF 1.027082, a different same-asset risk. Aggregating account headroom conceals the weaker account.

rules.rule: Test borrowing-cost and reward-budget shocks together
rules.proposed_limit: Remove 100% of captured external rewards and add 300 bp to the borrowing annual-cost input. Preserve a separate unstressed benchmark.
rules.limit_status: Explicit scenario inputs, not predicted market moves
rules.observed_risk: With both changes, the RLUSD full-parking illustration has negative total ETH income after the outer NAV fee even at constant ETH/USD.

rules.rule: Match withdrawal promises to repayable liquidity
rules.proposed_limit: Budget reserve cash, destination redemption capacity and collateral exit separately. No fixed universal exit SLA is asserted.
rules.limit_status: Operational funding requirement; capacities and account eligibility need execution testing
rules.observed_risk: Ethereum Aave USDC has $6.325m physical cash against $2.2466bn variable debt at T. Higher total deposits do not prove enough dollars for a deleveraging batch.

rules.proposed_limit: Count a held vault claim once, and show own-borrower interest recovery separately from external interest and subsidy income.
rules.limit_status: Accounting rule, not a proven safe concentration cap
rules.observed_risk: Liquid ETH holds 55.105m RLUSD in the vault that supplies its weETH/RLUSD borrowing market. The earlier fixed-block allocation diagnostic identifies about 8.709m RLUSD of indirect self-credit notional.

rules.rule: Apply fees at the correct layer
rules.proposed_limit: Use 0.35% annual outer Ethereum NAV fee for this scenario. Do not apply destination performance fees twice to a reported net destination base yield.
rules.limit_status: Observed Ethereum fee policy at T plus an annual fee scenario; other chains can differ
rules.observed_risk: RLUSD destination performanceFee is 10%; the PRIME/PYUSD destination is 15%. These are different from the ETH manager NAV fee.

rules.rule: Treat price, bridge and oracle marks as separate risks
rules.proposed_limit: Stress stablecoin exchange value and collateral-oracle discounts separately; preserve actual oracle units beside dollar assumptions.
rules.limit_status: Scenario accounting requirement; no stablecoin parity or reserve audit claimed
rules.observed_risk: The same market can have a $1 loan-unit convention, a collateral oracle and an ETH quote with a different timestamp. A positive modeled spread does not cover a depeg or recovery loss.

partners.role: Stablecoin funding and any subsidy budget
partners.first_candidate: RLUSD and PYUSD issuer/ecosystem teams, with Sentora as an existing integration lead
partners.selection_basis: Measured matching-currency loan and destination legs and documented issuer-vault relationships
partners.what_to_verify: Committed liquidity, budget funding address, duration, renewal rights, eligible holder, redemption and stablecoin conversion route
partners.existing_evidence: Primary case study links Sentora with both stablecoin ecosystems. It does not establish a funded offer for our product or identify the captured campaigns funders.

partners.first_candidate: Sentora; compare alternatives against the same risk and reporting requirements
partners.selection_basis: Observed RLUSD and PRIME vault allocations and documented curation role
partners.what_to_verify: Market caps, collateral concentration, reallocators, fee rights, oracle policy, withdrawal priority and who bears losses
partners.existing_evidence: The observed destination vaults give a concrete diligence starting point, not proof that their present allocation is suitable.

partners.first_candidate: Veda as the observed Ether.fi implementation reference
partners.selection_basis: Existing BoringVault, Accountant, Manager, Teller and queue contracts in the ETH product
partners.what_to_verify: Exact selectors/roles, fee permissions, rate publishing, cross-chain accounting, solver routes and change delays
partners.existing_evidence: The existing deployment is measurable. Its selected permissions are verified, but economic backing and every exit path are not fully reconciled.

partners.first_candidate: Nonce as the observed Liquid ETH strategy-provider reference
partners.selection_basis: Captured product interface identifies the provider; measured account and portfolio mechanics supply diligence cases
partners.what_to_verify: Debt hedge, keeper uptime, authority limits, withdrawal rehearsals, oracle/bridge incident response, reporting of self-credit and realized rewards
partners.existing_evidence: Provider identification is a separately dated UI statement, not a complete fixed-block map of every operator permission.

partners.first_candidate: Ether.fi ETH-holder interface; evaluate exchange/broker channels with an ETH-specific business case
partners.selection_basis: An existing ETH yield product distributes staking, looping and carry strategies through one interface
partners.what_to_verify: Deposit ownership, rewards ownership, exit communications, custody terms, commercial economics and support responsibility
partners.existing_evidence: BTC distribution success cannot be assumed to transfer to ETH. The present dataset does not measure acquisition costs or prove a channel wins on net yield.

partners.first_candidate: Separate contract/accounting reviewer and repay-liquidity providers selected against the actual contracts and asset routes
partners.selection_basis: The incomplete portfolio reconciliation and variable reserve cash create distinct review and execution tasks
partners.what_to_verify: Independent claim-graph reconciliation, simulation at the proposed size, price-impact bounds, executable repayment and queue settlement
partners.existing_evidence: Seven rate-model bytecodes match verified source at T. That proves model identity, not whole-product solvency or an executable exit.

limitations: The 18 Morpho markets are selected from an existing current discovery screen and verified at T; this is not an exhaustive ETH-collateral debt universe.
Morpho market debt is tied to its specific collateral, while Aave USDC reserve debt spans all supported collateral. These quantities cannot be added as ETH-only debt.
Main-vault and controlled LoanManager positions are tracked explicitly; absent tracked debt is null, not proof the market has no borrowers.
No stablecoin spot-price mark, dollar-to-ETH hedge, destination deposit capacity or exit execution is guaranteed by the annualized rates.
Borrow rates are variable and model curves are conditional, not forecasts.
Destination yield screens after T remain separately dated and are not substituted into historical financial observations.
